answer: In this PoA design, identity verification uses a Wesolowski VDF: each identity must perform a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings before its proof is accepted. Because every result depends on the preceding one, an attacker simulating many clones cannot divide one chain across GPUs or obtain proportional speedup; each clone still incurs real wall-clock delay. Labels such as timber, garden, and dune do not change this physical bottleneck.
